name: Calm Creepers
summary: Creepers still blow up and still hurt, but your walls, roofs and fields survive every blast without a single missing block.
logoPrompt: A small cosy wooden cottage standing completely unharmed while a puff of harmless green smoke drifts away beside it, flowers in front, in blocky voxel style

cover.tagline: The blast stays, the crater goes.
bullets: No more holes in your builds

description: **Calm Creepers keeps creepers dangerous but stops them from blowing holes into your builds and the landscape.**
- Creeper explosions no longer destroy blocks.
- Works for normal and charged creepers, and for creepers lit with flint and steel.
- Damage and knockback to players and mobs stay exactly as before, so a creeper is still a threat.
- TNT, ghasts, withers and all other explosions are left alone.
Import the .mcpack, then turn it on under Behavior Packs when you create or edit a world. Nothing else to set up.
- Made for Minecraft Bedrock 26.60 and newer. It can be added to or removed from an existing world at any time.
- Items lying on the ground can still be destroyed by the blast, like in the unchanged game.
- Like every behavior pack, it turns off achievements in the world it is added to.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
